metadata.description: Required. Sub Type (3-4 characters, e.g., SSV5, PRD, DEV)
Required. Service code (3 characters, e.g., AIE, AAD)
Required. Role code (3 characters, use INF for heterogeneous resource groups)
Required. Deployment Environment instance number (1 digit, 0-9)
Required. Region code (1 digit, e.g., 4 for UK South, 0 for Europe North)
Required. Instance number within the region (2 digits, 00-99)
Optional. Private link zone suffix (e.g. privatelink.cognitiveservices.azure.com). When set with privateLinkZoneResType, outputs privateLinkZoneName and privateLinkZoneResourceName.
Optional. Resource type code for the zone prefix (e.g. ADI, KVT). When set with privateLinkZoneSuffix, outputs privateLinkZoneName and privateLinkZoneResourceName.
Optional. Subnet name configs: array of {resType, instanceNumber}. When set, outputs subnetNames array. Config provides suffix (resType) per subnet; instanceNumber is 01, 02, etc.
Required. Sub Type (3-4 characters).
Required. Service code (3 characters).
Required. Role code (3 characters).
Required. Resource Type code (2-3 characters).
Required. Deployment Environment instance number (1 digit, 0-9).
Required. Region code (1 digit, e.g., 4 for UK South, 0 for Europe North).
Required. Instance number within the region (2 digits, 00-99, e.g., 00, 01, 02, 99). Must be numeric.
Optional. Whether to convert the output to lowercase. Default is false to preserve uppercase naming convention.

variables.resourceName: [format('{0}{1}{2}{3}{4}{5}', parameters('subType'), parameters('svc'), parameters('role'), parameters('resType'), parameters('deploymentEnvInstance'), variables('regionAndInstance'))]

routeTableName.value: [if(greater(length(reference(subscriptionResourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', format('rt-naming-{0}', uniqueString(deployment().name))), '2025-04-01').outputs.name.value), 2), substring(reference(subscriptionResourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', format('rt-naming-{0}', uniqueString(deployment().name))), '2025-04-01').outputs.name.value, 0, max(0, sub(length(reference(subscriptionResourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', format('rt-naming-{0}', uniqueString(deployment().name))), '2025-04-01').outputs.name.value), 2))), reference(subscriptionResourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', format('rt-naming-{0}', uniqueString(deployment().name))), '2025-04-01').outputs.name.value)]

privateLinkZoneName.value: [if(and(not(empty(parameters('privateLinkZoneSuffix'))), not(empty(parameters('privateLinkZoneResType')))), format('{0}.{1}', reference(subscriptionResourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deployments', format('pdz-naming-{0}', uniqueString(deployment().name, parameters('privateLinkZoneSuffix'), parameters('privateLinkZoneResType')))), '2025-04-01').outputs.name.value, parameters('privateLinkZoneSuffix')), '')]
